arxiv-2408-00398.title: Log Diameter Rounds MST Verification and Sensitivity in MPC
arxiv-2408-00398.creator: Sam Coy Artur Czumaj Gopinath Mishra Anish Mukherjee University of University of National University of University of Warwick Warwick Singapore Warwick
arxiv-2408-00398.description: Abstract We consider two natural variants of the problem of minimum spanning tree ( MST ) of a graph in the parallel setting: MST verification (verifying if a given tree is an MST ) and the sensitivity analysis of an MST (finding the lowest cost replacement edge for each edge of the MST ).

arxiv-2409-10659.title: Cavity-Enhanced Optical Manipulation of Antiferromagnetic Magnon-Pairs
arxiv-2409-10659.creator: Tahereh Sadat Parvini, Anna-Luisa E. Römling, Sanchar Sharma, Silvia Viola Kusminskiy
arxiv-2409-10659.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Tahereh Sadat Parvini, Anna-Luisa E. Römling, Sanchar Sharma, Silvia Viola Kusminskiy. The optical manipulation of magnon states in antiferromagnets (AFMs) holds significant potential for advancing AFM-based computing devices. In particular, two-magnon Raman scattering processes are known to generate entangled magnon-pairs with opposite momenta. We propose to harness the dynamical backaction of a driven optical cavity coupled to these processes, to obtain steady states of squeezed magnon-pairs, represented by squeezed Perelomov coherent states.

arxiv-2503-15484.title: Value Profiles for Encoding Human Variation
arxiv-2503-15484.creator: Taylor Sorensen, Pushkar Mishra, Roma Patel, Michael Henry Tessler, Michiel Bakker, Georgina Evans, Iason Gabriel, Noah Goodman, Verena Rieser
arxiv-2503-15484.description: Abstract Modelling human variation in rating tasks is crucial for personalization, pluralistic model alignment, and computational social science. We propose representing individuals using natural language value profiles – descriptions of underlying values compressed from in-context demonstrations – along with a steerable decoder model that estimates individual ratings from a rater representation.

arxiv-2505-06653.title: Improving Block-Wise LLM Quantization by 4-bit Block-Wise Optimal Float (BOF4): Analysis and Variations
arxiv-2505-06653.creator: Patrick Blumenberg, Thomas Graave, Tim Fingscheidt, Insitute for Communications Technology, Technische Universität Braunschweig, Germany
arxiv-2505-06653.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) demand extensive memory capacity during both fine-tuning and inference. To enable memory-efficient fine-tuning, existing methods apply block-wise quantization techniques, such as NF4 and AF4, to the network weights. We show that these quantization techniques incur suboptimal quantization errors. Therefore, as a first novelty, we propose an optimization approach for block-wise quantization.

pmc-12566566.creator: Rosa Sparaco, Pierfrancesco Cinque, Antonia Scognamiglio, Stefania Vertuccio, Giuseppe Caliendo, Ferdinando Fiorino, Angela Corvino, Elisa Magli, Elisa Perissutti, Vincenzo Santagada, Beatrice Severino, Giorgia Andreozzi, Paolo Luciano, Carmela Dell’Aversano, Alex Henrique Miller, Gilberto De Nucci,
pmc-12566566.description: 6-Nitrodopamine is an endogenous catecholamine responsible for numerous biological activities. The developed one-step synthetic procedures ensured the efficient preparation of the target compounds in good yields.

pmc-12655679.title: Outcomes of Hospitalized Octogenarians with E. coli Bacteremia—Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-12655679.creator: Alaa Atamna, Bayan Mahajneh, Yaara Wazana, Shahd Dahamsheh, Haim Ben-Zvi, Jihad Bishara, Maria Antonia De Francesco
pmc-12655679.description: Background: Escherichia coli (E. coli) bacteremia is a significant cause of mortality, particularly in older adults. Limited data exists on clinical outcomes in octogenarians. This study aims to evaluate the clinical outcomes of E. coli bacteremia in octogenarians and determine whether appropriate empirical therapy leads to improved outcomes in this specific population.

pmc-13350717.title: Associations between altered morphometric inverse divergence networks, choroid plexus volume, and perivascular space network in patients with Parkinson disease: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13350717.creator: Yuefei Liang, Guixing Fu, Sibo Huang, Wenjie He, Zekai Chen, Mengting Liu, Jun Xia
pmc-13350717.description: BackgroundRecent evidence suggests that Parkinson disease (PD) involves structural alterations in gray-matter volume, cortical surface area, and cortical thickness. Clinical symptoms of PD have also been associated with the choroid plexus (CP) volume and perivascular space (PVS) network parameters. However, the relationship between morphometric inverse divergence (MIND) network alterations and CP volume or PVS network parameters in PD remains unclear.

pmc-13401390.title: Development and External Validation of a Nomogram for Predicting Postherpetic Neuralgia Risk in Patients with Herpes Zoster: A Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-13401390.creator: Lulu Yan, Renyuan Deng, Hongguang Lu, Xiaoping Shen
pmc-13401390.description: BackgroundPostherpetic neuralgia (PHN) is a common and often debilitating complication of herpes zoster (HZ), particularly among older adults and immunocompromised individuals. Early identification of patients at high risk for PHN remains challenging in clinical practice.

pmc-13676985.title: The phosphate exporter XPR1 promotes gasdermin D–independent mature IL-1β secretion
pmc-13676985.creator: Nathalie Remy, Charlotte Six, Sandrine Tury, Emile Van Schaftingen, Jean-Luc Battini, Sophie Lucas, Pierre G Coulie, Tiphanie Gomard
pmc-13676985.description: Interleukin (IL)-1β is a leaderless inflammatory cytokine that is not secreted via the classical endoplasmic reticulum-Golgi pathway.
